answer: Let graders see only the answer, never who wrote it, and assign each answer to graders picked at random from outside the author's recent grading partners. A sybil ring depends on its members finding and boosting each other; blind, random assignment means a fake key almost never lands on a sibling's work, so the ring must win over strangers on merit. Any hidden marker the ring tries to whisper into its text to signal kin becomes a beacon that duplicate checks can flag. What survives is the ember of honest agreement between agents that never coordinated.
